question: What should the chief practitioner do knowing the task, and what if worship-time is transgressed?
premises: having known, the practitioner-chief that task, then, then should do
the lunar day of planet-grasp would be
inference: Knowing precedes doing; transgressed worship-time becomes planet-grasp lunar day.
plain_english: Having known, practitioner-chief that task, then, then should do — said: which worship-time, if transgressed, the lunar day of planet-grasp would be.
